description.value:
Martial Arts (×2) is learned one Form at a time; each Form is its own Skill. Martial Arts Attacks are ROF2, ignore half armor and deal Brawling damage by BODY. Every Form has two Special Moves, and all Forms share Recovery.

Special Moves

  • Disarming Combination: Hit one target with a Brawling and a MA Attack this Turn. DV15: take or drop one held item.
  • Iron Grip: You have a target Grabbed (not already Iron Gripped). Action, DV15: their escapes are at −2 more and they can't make Ranged Attacks until the Grapple breaks.

Special Move resolution: DEX + Form Skill + 1d10 vs the target's DEX + Evasion + 1d10, or the DV listed. Special Moves can't be Aimed Shots unless they say so. "Once per Turn" means once per your Turn.

Recovery (shared): when you use Get Up, beat DV13 and it costs no Action. Not with a Broken or Dismembered Leg.

Item Compendium (2070) • Martial Arts
